hooks.name: Keep docs true to the code
hooks.description: After bridge or mod source edits, reminds the agent to update docs/*.md so the published docs keep matching the code.

action.prompt: A bridge or mod source file was just saved. Before you finish, check whether the change alters anything documented in docs/*.md (endpoints, hook triggers, limits, timeouts, file paths, commands, test counts, Kiro integration). If it does, update the matching doc in the same change, following .kiro/steering/writing-style.md. The docs promise that every statement was checked against the source, so never leave a stale number or name. If nothing documented changed, say so in one line.
